data.query: Generate an executive sales report summarizing our product performance.

sections.heading: Executive Summary
sections.content: The company generated a total net revenue of $2,945 across 15 orders, with a total of 87 units sold. The business achieved a net profit of $1,525.50, representing a gross margin of 51.8%.

sections.heading: Category Performance
sections.content: Sales are split almost evenly between two categories: Accessories (51.27% of revenue) and Electronics (48.73% of revenue). Accessories outperformed in volume with 54 units sold compared to 33 units in Electronics.

sections.heading: Top Product Performance
sections.content: The top-performing product by revenue is the USB-C Hub, contributing $640 (21.73% of total revenue). Other key contributors include the Gaming Headset ($480) and Mechanical Keyboard ($480). The Wireless Mouse and Monitor Light Bar round out the top five products.
